validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: high confidence — this is the KRG government's new 36-in gas pipeline from the Khor Mor/Chemchemal fields to Erbil (KAR Group EPC), phase 1 of the KRG gas-network project whose phase 2 is Erbil-Duhok (= P4053, 52-in). Independently attested by Rudaw Arabic (2022-02-08, the wiki's own citation — live, JS-rendered so Arabic tokens need 'كورمور'/'أربيل'; content confirmed: 36-in Khor Mor->Erbil, 52-in Erbil->Duhok, Kar Group, agreement signed Jan 2021), Zawya Projects (2022-07-05: '36-inch pipeline from the Khor Mor and Chemchemal gas fields to Erbil and a 52-inch pipeline from Erbil to Dohuk'; KAR appointed EPC Dec 2021), Iraq Oil Report (2023-08-09), Kurdistan24 (2025-10-28), and Dana Gas company reporting on the 'government-backed common-user pipeline' from Khor Mor (commissioning expected H2 2026). NOT GEM-derived; not a phantom. DUPLICATE: distinct from P4053 (Erbil-Duhok 52-in, inaugurated 2025-10-28, 192-198 km, $591M) and distinct from the EXISTING operating Pearl/Dana 24-in Khor Mor->Chamchamal->Erbil line (58+116 km, ~174-180 km, running since ~2008-09) — do not conflate; sources about 'the Khor Mor-Erbil pipeline' must be checked for which line they mean. CLASSIFICATION: gas transmission trunk for power supply — correct. ATTRIBUTION CAVEAT: the sheet's current ref for Status/Fuel/PipelineType/Diameter (iraqoilreport.com .../45995, published 2023-08-09) passes url_verifier on tokens 'Khor Mor'/'36'/'Erbil' but its actual text reads 'Construction has begun on a 36-inch pipeline running from Erbil to a power plant in Dohuk' — i.e. its 36-in figure is the Erbil-Duhok line (which GEM/P4053 records as 52-in; IOR vs Rudaw/Zawya disagree about THAT line, a P4053 problem). It does not state a diameter for Khor Mor-Erbil, so it mis-supports this row's Diameter. SPEC: Diameter 36 in confirmed by 2 independent verified sources (Rudaw 2022-02, Zawya 2022-07) — keep value, swap ref. ProposalYear 2022 conflicts with both sources (agreement Jan 2021, EPC award Dec 2021) — recommend 2021. ConstructionYear 2022 is consistent with the Feb 2022 project launch coverage (Rudaw) though physical progress has been slow (MEES Nov 2024 reported ~2-year delay vs a 2H 2024 target; completion now expected 2026). Length: no independent figure found for the NEW 36-in line (the ~174-180 km figures in circulation are the old 24-in line) — correctly left blank; do not transplant. Capacity: no public figure for the line itself (it is sized to evacuate KM250's +250 MMscf/d and future Chemchemal volumes) — leave blank.

fills.researcher_notes: Ref REPLACEMENT, not a blank fill: the current IOR ref's '36-inch' sentence describes the Erbil-Duhok line, not this one. Zawya 2022-07-05 ('36-inch pipeline from the Khor Mor and Chemchemal gas fields to Erbil'; verified tokens '36-inch','Khor Mor','Erbil','KAR Group','December 2021','52-inch') and Rudaw Arabic 2022-02-08 (36-in Khor Mor->Erbil; verified tokens 'كورمور','أربيل','36') independently agree with GEM's 36 in.

Rudaw Arabic 2022-02-08 covers the launch of the KRG pipeline-extension works (Kar Group; 36-in to Erbil), contemporaneous with the recorded ConstructionYear 2022; Zawya 2022-07-05 shows execution underway that year (phase-1 completion then targeted Apr-May 2023). Neither source states a groundbreaking date verbatim, hence medium tier; physical works subsequently slipped badly (MEES 2024-11: ~2-year delay).

Zawya: the 36-in line runs 'from the Khor Mor and Chemchemal gas fields to Erbil' — note Chemchemal field is also a planned source (Pearl deals target Chemchemal gas from 2027), so FuelSource could be extended to 'Khormor, Chemchemal'. Dana Gas KRI page ties the government-backed common-user pipeline to Khor Mor output evacuation.

Endpoints Khor Mor field (Chamchamal district, Sulaymaniyah governorate, Kurdistan Region) -> Erbil confirmed by Zawya (route statement) and Kurdistan24 2025-10-28 (Khor Mor-Chamchamal leg in Sulaimani province; network feeds Erbil). StartLocation could usefully be filled as 'Khor Mor field, Chamchamal' — currently blank in the sheet.

No source states '100%' verbatim, but ownership by the KRG is well supported: Zawya — the KRG Ministry of Natural Resources appointed KAR Group as EPC contractor (KAR is contractor, not owner); Dana Gas calls it the 'government-backed common-user pipeline'. Medium tier because the 100% share is inferred from it being a government project with no reported equity partners.

Deliberately NOT filled: both verified sources contradict the recorded ProposalYear 2022 — Rudaw (2022-02-08) says the agreement with Kar Group was signed January 2021; Zawya says KAR was appointed EPC in December 2021. Recommend changing ProposalYear to 2021 (ProposalMonth 1 per Rudaw, or 12/2021 per Zawya EPC award) and citing these two refs; filling a 2022 ref would pair a ref with a value the source disputes.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status 'construction' CONFIRMED with evidence newer than LastUpdated 2025-07-15, and explicitly NOT yet operating. (1) Dana Gas KRI operations page + FY2025 results (Feb 2026): KM250 output 'expected to ramp up during 2026 and achieve full capacity upon commissioning of the government-backed common-user pipeline, anticipated in the second half of 2026' — this common-user pipeline is the KRG 36-in Khor Mor->Erbil evacuation route; not commissioned as of Feb 2026. (2) Kurdistan24 2025-10-28 (Erbil-Duhok inauguration): PM Barzani said the Khor Mor-Chamchamal pipeline extension project in Sulaimani province is underway/forthcoming — i.e. the upstream leg of this route was still being executed in Oct 2025 (The New Region same day: 'another project is underway in Sulaimani province to extend the gas pipeline between Khor Mor and Chamchamal'). Context: MEES (2024-11) reported ~2-year slippage vs the original 2H 2024 completion target; the Erbil-Duhok sister line (P4053) was inaugurated 2025-10-28, but gas currently reaching Erbil/Duhok flows via the old Pearl/Dana 24-in line. No source claims the 36-in line is complete or operating, so no status change; revisit after H2 2026 for expected commissioning -> operating (would set StartYear1 2026/2027).

summary: P4047 confirmed real and distinct (KRG/KAR 36-in Khor Mor->Erbil common-user line, commissioning expected H2 2026): status construction confirmed (Feb 2026 evidence); diameter 36 in re-sourced (current IOR ref's 36-inch actually describes Erbil-Duhok); ProposalYear likely 2021 not 2022; 4 blank refs filled, length/capacity left blank (no independent figures for the new line).
